title: implement all_reduce

atoms.evidence: def reduce(tensor, rank, world_size, dst=0, op): / def all_reduce(tensor, rank, world_size, op): — both take (rank, world_size) explicitly
if rank != dst: dist.send(tensor, dst=dst) else: ... dist.recv(received_tensor, src=other_rank) — matched send/recv primitive in reduce

for other_rank in range(world_size): if other_rank != dst: received_tensor = t.zeros_like(tensor); dist.recv(received_tensor, src=other_rank); tensor += received_tensor — dst loops recv into fresh buffers and accumulates
def all_reduce(...): reduce(tensor, rank, world_size, dst=0, op=op); broadcast(tensor, rank, world_size, src=0) — literal reduce-then-broadcast composition
if op == 'mean': tensor /= world_size — implement mean by sum-then-divide-in-place
dist.init_process_group(backend='nccl', rank=rank, world_size=world_size) ... dist.destroy_process_group() inside run_simple_model
mp.spawn(run_simple_model, args=(world_size,), nprocs=world_size, join=True) — canonical entry point
device = t.device(f'cuda:{rank}'); model = SimpleModel().to(device) — each rank pins to one GPU by index
model = SimpleModel().to(device); input = t.tensor([rank], dtype=t.float32, device=device)
self.param = t.nn.Parameter(t.tensor([2.0])) inside SimpleModel — the toy class wraps a scalar so it's optimizable
all_reduce(model.param.grad, rank, world_size) — the run_simple_model demo applies the just-implemented all_reduce to a single param.grad, foreshadowing the DDP pattern in 0_3_11
output = model(input); loss = output.pow(2).sum(); loss.backward(); optimizer.step() — degenerate training step inside the demo driver
loss = output.pow(2).sum(); loss.backward() inside the demo
